{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling potential errors
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors (non-numeric values)
print("Number of rows with invalid revenue:", sales['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Display the first few rows after conversion
display(sales.head())"}
